purpose: Preregister, before any parent geometry is retrieved, how Gate C subcheck C6d compares the union of the nine frozen MINAM N7 children with an independently frozen official N6 parent 137596 (Cuenca Casma).

preregistration_timing.statement: Written and committed before the parent query with returnGeometry=true was ever issued. Only layer metadata and a returnCountOnly identity query were inspected. The parent capture manifest records the SHA-256 of this file at capture time; Gate C evaluation refuses to run if it differs.

source.institution: Autoridad Nacional del Agua (ANA), institutional service published on the Infraestructura de Datos Espaciales del Peru (IDEP)

alternatives_considered.disposition: Not verifiable from the research fetcher (robots/connection timeout); no N6 service URL could be confirmed.
Previously recorded as DNS-unresolved from CI (config/phase2_casma_n7_geometry_source_gap_v0_1.json).

identity_rules: Exactly one feature in the response.
Geometry has at least one ring; every ring closed.
Name fields (NOMB_UH_N6, NOMBRE) and AREA_KM2 are recorded, never gating.

crs_rules.rationale: Same rule as Gate A: request outSR equal to the declared storage CRS (sourceSpatialReference). A FeatureServer query without outSR returns the service SR (102100), i.e. a server projection.
crs_rules.datum_transformation: None. Parent (EPSG:4326) and children (EPSG:32718) are both WGS84.

children_union_reference.definition: The single reduced boundary loop of the nine frozen native EPSG:32718 children (Gate C C5), inverse-projected to WGS84 lon/lat with the Krueger 6th-order UTM 18S series in scripts/qa_phase2_casma_n7_gate_c_topology.py. The parent is never derived from this union.

M1_p90_boundary_distance.definition: Densify the union boundary and every parent ring at spacing <= densification_spacing_m (vertices included). For every sample, compute the Euclidean distance to the other boundary in the local tangent-plane frame centred at local_frame_origin_lonlat. Pool both directions and take the nearest-rank 90th percentile.

M2_symmetric_difference_ratio.definition: area(U xor P) / area(P), with areas on the WGS84 ellipsoid via Lambert cylindrical equal-area and area(U n P) from the boundary-integral method in scripts/c6d_parent_comparison.py.

report_only: area ratio and signed area difference
children area outside parent (total and per child)
parent AREA_KM2 attribute vs computed area

tolerance.tau_basis: US National Map Accuracy Standard horizontal limit for scales smaller than 1:20,000 (1/50 inch at map scale) applied to the documented 1:100,000 source scale of the Pfafstetter coverage (IGN 1:100,000 base, ANA0000383): 0.000508 m x 100000 = 50.8 m, evaluated as a 90th percentile as in that standard.
tolerance.sdr_bound_basis: Area swept if every union boundary point were displaced by tau: tau x perimeter(U) / area(U) = 50.8 x 283455.9597 / 2985080248.70.

NOT_EVALUABLE: Parent capture absent, source unavailable, or capture manifest/hash verification fails.
Response is not exactly one feature satisfying the identity rules.
Declared layer sourceSpatialReference or response spatialReference differs from 4326.
Capture manifest does not record this preregistration's SHA-256, or the comparison module SHA-256 differs from comparison_module_sha256.
Parent geometry fails the Gate C C1/C3 validity rules (unclosed ring, repeated vertex, self-intersection), so the metrics are undefined.
decision_rules.PASS: Evaluable and M1 <= tau_m and M2 <= sdr_bound.
decision_rules.FAIL: Evaluable and (M1 > tau_m or M2 > sdr_bound).
decision_rules.effect_on_gate_c: C6d PASS allows C6 PASS if C6a-C6c pass; C6d FAIL makes Gate C FAIL; NOT_EVALUABLE keeps Gate C NOT_PASS_PENDING.

post_capture_rules: tau_m, sdr_bound, metric definitions, densification spacing, frame origin and the comparison module must not change after capture.
Any post-capture change is a protocol deviation that must be recorded and cannot yield PASS.
A PASS establishes spatial coherence of the current MINAM N7 children with the current ANA N6 parent only. It does not establish Uh_pfas100 equivalence, modify Gate B, or authorize map publication.
